title: Machine learning-based gait analysis to predict clinical frailty scale in elderly patients with heart failure
summary: Smartphone pose estimation plus LightGBM enabled automated frailty scoring in older heart-failure patients, and scores were associated with subsequent mortality. Prospective derivation/validation cohorts and mortality follow-up; observational association only, not intervention benefit.
ai_technology: smartphone pose estimation extracted gait features and LightGBM predicted clinical frailty score in seven-centre prospective cohort.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: derivation n=194 and validation n=223; predicted frailty also associated with later mortality.
evidence.unknown: Prospective derivation/validation cohorts and mortality follow-up; observational association only, not intervention benefit. The source does not establish benefits beyond the reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: smartphone pose estimation extracted gait features and LightGBM predicted clinical frailty score in seven-centre prospective cohort.
